title: The Singhs Survive in Hiding, Hunger, and Motion

blocks.text: The persecution drives the community into every kind of concealment. Some are hiding in ravines and forests, others in distant villages or among sympathetic households, while still others try to pass as ordinary cultivators living close to the soil.

The page emphasizes repeated hunger as part of this wandering life. Many eat only every second or fourth day, count wild greens and bark as food, and treat even a little salt as a luxury when the state has made normal living impossible.

Yet the Singhs do not simply disappear. Informers trail them, soldiers are summoned whenever they are spotted, and the Nawab’s written orders begin turning daily survival into a moving battle against a hostile countryside.
